text:
The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**: the $20,000 price, less the $5,000 saved by not finishing, less the $1,000 he got from reselling the materials. The $3,000 property-value gain doesn't reduce an expectation recovery under the usual rule (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §347). The team note that courts always split the loss evenly is not a general rule, so I'm not applying it.

CONFIDENCE: 75
